headline: G2 GOLDFIELDS TAKEN OUT: G Mining Ventures Acquires Guyana Gold Discoverer; Vote June 16
snippet: G2 Goldfields (TSX: GTWO) filed meeting materials for a June 16 shareholder vote on its acquisition by G Mining Ventures — the mine builder behind Tocantinzinho in Brazil — with a concurrent spin-out into G3 Goldfields preserving exploration upside from the high-grade OKO deposit in Guyana, which drilling has traced to 1 km depth at over 3 g/t Au.

headline: NEXGEN'S ROOK I GOES TO CONSTRUCTION THIS SUMMER: 30 Mlb/yr Uranium Giant Approved in Saskatchewan
snippet: NexGen Energy (TSX: NXE) is preparing to break ground this summer on Rook I in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin — the largest development-stage uranium deposit in Canada and capable of supplying over 20% of global uranium fuel at peak production of 30 million pounds per year; the project received final federal approval in March 2026 after more than a decade of development.

headline: ARGENTINA EPITHERMAL CONFIRMED: Latin Metals Drills 8.83 g/t Au and 739 g/t Ag at Cerro Bayo
snippet: Latin Metals confirmed a large epithermal gold-silver system at Cerro Bayo in Argentina with partner-funded Phase I drilling intersecting multiple mineralized zones, including high-grade intervals up to 8.83 g/t Au and 739 g/t Ag over the 1,850-metre program; Cerro Bayo is a historically significant silver-gold mining district in Patagonia.

headline: OREZONE DRILLS 16.10 g/t Au Over 6.7m at Casa Berardi — First Results from Quebec Acquisition
snippet: Orezone Gold (TSX: ORE) released its first drill results since acquiring the Casa Berardi gold mine in Quebec, returning 16.10 g/t Au over 6.7m and 6.47 g/t Au over 21.5m from the F160 and F134 near-surface zones; the company plans 40,000–60,000m of drilling in 2026 to support pit expansions and prove down-plunge grade continuity at the established mine.

headline: NEXGOLD EXPANDS GOLDLUND: Broad High-Grade Intercepts Confirm Ontario Gold Resource Continuity
snippet: NexGold Mining (TSX: NEXG) reported broad, high-grade gold intercepts from ongoing diamond drilling at Goldlund within the Goliath Gold Complex in northwestern Ontario, reinforcing mineral resource continuity across the deposit and highlighting expansion potential that could support a larger resource base ahead of a development decision.

headline: LITHIUM SUPPLY SQUEEZE: China Carbonate Hits Two-Year Highs as VAT Cut and Feedstock Crunch Collide
snippet: Battery-grade lithium carbonate in China rose 23.3% month-on-month to near two-year highs as of mid-May, driven by the removal of VAT export rebates on lithium-ion batteries from April 1, tightening feedstock supply, and record EV output of 1.32 million units in April; spodumene concentrate prices rose 29.9% over the same period, pressuring downstream producers globally.
